name: Jonas Schmedtmann
aboutMe: Hi, I'm Jonas — a full-stack web developer and online instructor with over 10 years of experience in the industry. I specialize in building modern, responsive, and high-performance web applications using technologies like JavaScript, React, Node.js, and more. My mission is to help students gain real-world skills by teaching complex topics in a clear and practical way. Over the years, I’ve taught thousands of developers through my courses, and I’m passionate about making high-quality education accessible to everyone. Whether you're just starting out or looking to deepen your skills, you're in the right place.
